svg.title: Inject Se/TOP rapidly by syringe · conceptual
svg.desc: Inject the 1 mmol Se precursor in a few milliliters of TOP quickly by syringe into the rapidly stirring solution. Stirring and injection rates are not numeric. Conceptual action diagram. The source says reaction flask; its shape, neck count, volume, fill and heating apparatus are not specified. Arrows indicate an action only. No missing reactor value, phase handling or rate is inferred from this drawing.
